traits.name: Swiftness
traits.text: The living thunderclap doesn't trigger reactions when it moves.

traits.name: Thunderbolt
traits.text: ⬺ (electricity, evocation, primal, sonic); The living thunderclap emits a bolt of lightning that crashes with deafening thunder. The living thunderclap makes a lightning bolt Strike that deals 1d12 (1d12) electricity damage. If it hits, the target and any creatures within a 15-foot emanation around the target take 2d6 (2d6) sonic damage and must attempt a DC 18 basic Fortitude save. Any creature that fails its save is also deafened for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ gust +14 (agile, finesse); Damage 2d6+6 (2d6+6) bludgeoning plus Push 5 feet

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ lightning bolt +14 (electricity, range increment 50 feet); Damage 2d12 (2d12) electricity
